name: exa-search
title: Exa Search
description: AI-powered search that understands your queries and delivers precise, context-aware results quickly
author: thomas

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Exa
commands.subtitle: Find relevant results
commands.description: Search the web using Exa's neural search.

commands.name: answer
commands.title: Ask Exa
commands.subtitle: Get answers to questions
commands.description: Ask a question and get an answer based on search results.

commands.name: find-similar
commands.title: Find Similar
commands.subtitle: Find related webpages
commands.description: Find webpages similar to a given URL.

commands.name: open-in-browser
commands.title: Open in Browser
commands.description: Opens the Exa Search in your browser.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search
tools.description: Perform an Exa search given an input query and retrieve a list of relevant results as links, including a summary of the content.

tools.name: find-similar
tools.title: Find Similar
tools.description: Find a list of similar results based on a webpage's URL, including a summary of each result.

tools.name: get-contents
tools.title: Get Contents
tools.description: Retrieves the full text of a webpage given its URL.

tools.name: get-answer
tools.title: Get Answer
tools.description: Get an answer to a question informed by Exa search results.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
